crossRefs.note: When the whirlwind passes, the wicked is no more; but the righteous stand firm forever.
I have seen the foolish taking root, but suddenly I cursed his habitation.
He will not be rich, neither will his substance continue, neither will their possessions be extended on the earth.
that the triumphing of the wicked is short, the joy of the godless but for a moment?
Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare clothing as the clay;
The wicked desires the plunder of evil men, but the root of the righteous flourishes.
he who doesn’t lend out his money for usury, nor take a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things shall…
Those who trust in Yahweh are as Mount Zion, which can’t be moved, but remains forever.
As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so Yahweh surrounds his people from this time forward and forever more.
Blessed is your discretion, and blessed are you, who have kept me today from blood guiltiness, and from avenging myself…
that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith, to the end that you, being rooted and grounded in love,
rooted and built up in him, and established in the faith, even as you were taught, abounding in it in thanksgiving.

translations.web: A man shall not be established by wickedness, but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.
translations.bsb: A man cannot be established through wickedness, but the righteous cannot be uprooted.
translations.kjv: A man shall not be established by wickedness: but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.
translations.asv: A man shall not be established by wickedness; But the root of the righteous shall not be moved.
